openings.claim: Separate lateral registration from strap compression: four strips form two bolted, padded removable external rim clamps with registration faces; straps retain separation. Preserve ordinary strap-retention and spacer-clearance functions. Right-contact card → ruler-confirmed height increase → manually raise right-retainer clearance by that increase before tensioning; card stays positioned.
openings.discriminator: Against increased left-corner compression, registration faces should carry sideways load with lighter strap tension; rival risks opposite-corner lift (2 mm in three supplied trials). Disturbed adjustment should preserve horizontal registration without extra left compression. Neither seal continuity nor established performance is predicted. Compare using those three supplied rival trials; further rival effects remain unknown.
openings.probe: Before fabrication, confirm damage-free rim grip, strap-anchor reach, opening clearance upon release/removal, twenty-minute measurement feasibility and ruler resolution; otherwise stop or regard disturbance detection as uninformative. Build one configuration within ninety minutes; drill only strips, tether detachable parts with cord. Twelve closure/pull trials: ten numbered opening cycles, nominal false-signal trial with intentionally premature clearance adjustment (cancel when no measured height increase), then final measured-adjustment right-card trial. Record displacement, opposite-corner lift, 20 N resistance, reopening time and seal condition. Reject failed cancellation, escaping straps, slipping clamps, insufficient card clearance, displacement >1 mm, reopening >30 seconds or new tears.
openings.uncertainty: Rim geometry, external-clamp accessibility and strap reach are unspecified; strips/bolts permitting registration and adjustable clearance without permanent deformation is assumed. Twelve measurements within twenty minutes and ruler resolution need confirmation. Deployment and reliable performance remain unestablished.

lineage.reason: Preserves relation, rival/defeat tests, uncertain fit and resource/stopping caveats.

decision: Conditional probe only. Retain existing hatch, rim and seal; no drilling, cutting, gluing or permanent deformation of hatch/trough. Full marked opening clears when open; no powered mechanism; loose parts recoverable. After ten cycles and final disturbance require ≤1 mm registration, 20 N resistance, ≤30-second one-technician reopening and no new visible seal tears; only disturbed seal-contact continuity is exempt.
